translations.english: Both beautiful and excellent cities were adorned with extensive areas, featuring principal houses that were very charming and resembled celestial chariots.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे“ वृत्रेण निर्जिता ।” हे विष्णो ! जब से वह तुम्हारा प्रोतिपात्र बना हे, तभी से बह लोको का मालिक हो गया हे
